definition_en: a name or title that identifies a person or thing
core_image: 贴在身上的名字牌：一个称呼被郑重地安放到人或物的身上
scene: 新酒庄开张那天，庄主向众人宣布了酒的名字。The appellation on the bottle told exactly where the grapes were grown.
sceneCN: 这里 appellation 是「名称、产地命名」（第 2 个义项：正式的名称或标识）；句意为：瓶身上的命名标明了葡萄的产地。

derivatives.zh: 同根词，由 appellare（呼唤）发展，义为「呼吁；上诉」
同根派生，义为「上诉的；受理上诉的」
加形容词后缀 -ive，义为「命名的；通名的」

senses.title: A name given to a person
senses.definition: a title or descriptive name attached to a person
senses.definitionCN: 附加在某人身上的称号或描述性名称
senses.example: She earned the appellation of iron chancellor.
senses.exampleCN: 她赢得了铁血首相的称号。
senses.why: To call someone by a name is the root act, so personal titles come first.
senses.whyCN: 用名字称呼某人是最根本的动作，所以个人称号排第一。

senses.title: A formal identifying name
senses.definition: an official or formal name marking what something is or where it comes from
senses.definitionCN: 标明某物身份或来源的正式名称
senses.example: The region's appellation guarantees the wine's origin.
senses.exampleCN: 该产区的命名保证了葡萄酒的来源。
senses.why: Calling a thing by its proper name extends the calling act to labels and marks.
senses.whyCN: 以专名呼唤一物，使「呼唤」的动作延伸到标签与标识上。

senses.title: A word or phrase used in naming
senses.definition: a word or expression that functions as a name in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 在口语或书面中充当名称的词语
senses.example: Genius is a grand appellation for a young writer.
senses.exampleCN: 对一个年轻作家来说，天才是个了不得的称呼。
senses.why: The name itself becomes an object we can quote, discuss, or admire.
senses.whyCN: 名字本身成为可引用、可讨论、可赞叹的对象。

senses.title: A classifying label
senses.definition: a general term that places a thing in a category rather than identifying it singly
senses.definitionCN: 把事物归入类别而非单独指认的通名
senses.example: Tree is an appellation covering many species.
senses.exampleCN: 树是涵盖许多物种的通名。
senses.why: Calling can sort as well as single out, giving the class-name sense.
senses.whyCN: 呼唤既能单独指认也能分类排序，于是产生通名义。

senses.title: A nickname or byname
senses.definition: an informal or affectionate name used instead of the real one
senses.definitionCN: 代替真名使用的非正式或亲昵称呼
senses.example: The appellation Shorty stuck with him for years.
senses.exampleCN: 小矮个这个绰号跟了他好多年。
senses.why: People also call each other by invented names, so nicknames join the family.
senses.whyCN: 人们也会用自创的名字互相称呼，绰号因此归入此族。

senses.title: A legal or official designation
senses.definition: the precise name by which a person or entity is designated in documents
senses.definitionCN: 文件中对人或实体指定的精确名称
senses.example: The contract listed her full appellation.
senses.exampleCN: 合同列出了她的完整称谓。
senses.why: Documents demand the exact calling name, adding a formal register.
senses.whyCN: 文件要求确切的称呼名，于是有了正式语体。

senses.title: A title of honor or shame
senses.definition: a name that carries praise or blame onto its bearer
senses.definitionCN: 给承受者带来赞誉或贬责的名号
senses.example: Traitor is an appellation no soldier wants.
senses.exampleCN: 叛徒是士兵都不想要的名号。
senses.why: Names carry feeling, so an appellation can honor or wound.
senses.whyCN: 名字承载情感，称谓因此可以荣耀人也可以刺伤人。

senses.title: A geographical origin name
senses.definition: a protected name showing the geographic origin of a product, especially wine
senses.definitionCN: 标示产品地理来源的受保护名称，尤指葡萄酒
senses.example: Champagne is a protected appellation in Europe.
senses.exampleCN: 香槟在欧洲是受保护的产地命名。
senses.why: Because calling fixes identity, place names became protected appellations.
senses.whyCN: 由于命名固定身份，地名便成为受保护的产地命名。

intro.en: Appellation descends from Latin appellare, to address or call upon, through the noun appellatio, a naming.
intro.cn: appellation 源自拉丁语 appellare（称呼、呼唤），经名词 appellatio（命名）传承而来。

items.en: The reconstructed root *pel- meant to thrust or drive, later Latin pellere.
items.cn: 重构词根 *pel- 意为「推动、驱使」，后成拉丁语 pellere。

items.en: Appellare, ad- plus pellere, meant to drive toward, hence to address someone by name.
items.cn: appellare 由 ad- 加 pellere 构成，本义「向……驱使」，引申为「以名字称呼某人」。

items.en: Appellatio meant a naming or designation, both of persons and of things.
items.cn: appellatio 意为命名、称谓，既指人也指物。

items.en: appellation kept the naming sense and the legal calling sense in medieval French.
items.cn: appellation 在中世纪法语中保留命名义与法律传唤义。

items.en: English borrowed appellation in the fifteenth century, first in legal use.
items.cn: 英语于十五世纪借入 appellation，最初用于法律语境。

items.en: It now names any title or designation, including protected wine origin names.
items.cn: 如今它泛指任何称号或命名，包括受保护的葡萄酒产地名称。

note.en: Appellation shares its root with call-words and overlaps with naming synonyms.
note.cn: appellation 与同根「呼唤」词族共享词源，并与命名类近义词交叠。

entries.definition: relating to courts that hear appeals
entries.definitionCN: 与受理上诉的法院有关的

entries.definition: an earnest request or a request to a higher court
relating to naming; a common noun as a name
entries.definitionCN: 命名的；作名称用的普通名词

entries.definition: a name describing rank, position, or a work

normalIntro.en: Use the appellare family to fix appellation in memory.
normalIntro.cn: 利用 appellare 词族把 appellation 记牢。

normal.en: appellation = appeal + -ation: the act of calling becomes a name.
normal.cn: appellation = appeal + -ation：呼唤的动作变成名字。

normal.en: Same root as appellate court, both from Latin appellare, to call.
normal.cn: 与 appellate court 同根，都来自拉丁语 appellare（呼唤）。

normal.en: Wine labels use appellation for origin names, e.g. Champagne.
normal.cn: 酒标用 appellation 表示产地命名，如香槟。

normal.en: Ad- (toward) + pellere (drive): driving a name toward someone.
normal.cn: ad-（朝向）+ pellere（驱使）：把名字驱向某人。

normal.en: Pair it: earn the appellation of hero.
normal.cn: 记搭配：earn the appellation of hero（赢得英雄称号）。

abstract.en: Picture a brass nameplate being nailed onto someone's door.
abstract.cn: 想象一块铜名牌被钉上某人的家门。

abstract.en: The name tag floats down and sticks to a bottle of wine.
abstract.cn: 名字牌飘落，贴上一瓶葡萄酒。

abstract.en: Appellation sounds like 'a pal nation' — everyone in the pal nation has a title.
abstract.cn: appellation 听着像 a pal nation——伙伴国里人人都有称号。

examples.en: The city deserved its appellation as the pearl of the north.
examples.cn: 这座城市无愧于北方明珠的称号。

examples.en: Under the appellation of hereditary king, he ruled for decades.
examples.cn: 他以世袭国王的名号统治了几十年。

examples.en: Scholars debated whether the appellation was accurate.
examples.cn: 学者们争论这个称呼是否准确。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿婆蕾申」——阿婆举着蕾丝花边的名牌给你命名，谐音仅助记，别当词源。

root: 拉丁词根 pell-（驱使、推动）：ad-（朝向）+ pellere 构成 appellare（呼唤、称呼），其名词 appellatio 即「命名、称号」，进入法语后由英语借为 appellation。

sensesIntro.en: From the act of calling someone by name, appellation expands to formal names, class labels, nicknames, legal designations, honorific or shaming titles, and protected origin names.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「以名呼唤」的动作出发，appellation 依次铺开到正式名称、归类标签、绰号、法律称谓、褒贬头衔以及受保护的产地命名。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a name being solemnly attached to a person or thing
core.cn: 核心意象：一个名字被郑重地安放到人或物身上

branches.en: names attached to people: titles, nicknames, labels of honor or shame
branches.cn: 安在人身上的名字：称号、绰号、褒贬名号

branches.en: the name as a word we quote and discuss
branches.cn: 作为可引用词语的名字

branches.en: class names that sort things into categories

branches.cn: 产品的受保护地理命名

intro.en: Appellation is assembled from transparent Latin parts, each still productive in English.
intro.cn: appellation 由透明度很高的拉丁部件拼成，这些部件在英语里仍很能产。

latinIntro.en: The engine is pellere, to drive, joined to ad- and the noun suffix -ation.
latinIntro.cn: 动力核心是 pellere（驱使），接上 ad- 与名词后缀 -ation。
